description: Capture a screenshot (page or element). Default is JPEG (quality 70) at CSS-pixel size, which is several times smaller than PNG and reads fine. Pass format:"png" for lossless, quality 1-100 for JPEG, scale 2 for device pixels on a Retina display or 0.5 to shrink.

allFrames.description: Act on the first match in ANY frame (the element may be in an iframe)

name: screenshot
